quarterly_data.quarter: Rorze TDnet: Consolidated Financial Results for the Six Months Ended (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Results for the six months ended August 31, 2026 (March - August 2026, first half of the fiscal year ending February 28, 2027; English TDnet earnings release): net sales JPY 79,733 million (up 21.5% year on year from JPY 65,602 million), operating profit JPY 23,096 million (up 42.4%), ordinary profit JPY 24,538 million (up 68.4%; foreign exchange gains of JPY 1,589 million against foreign exchange losses of JPY 2,368 million a year earlier), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 15,839 million (up 45.7%). The half includes an extraordinary loss of JPY 2,158 million for a litigation settlement.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 79,733 million (+21.5%); operating profit JPY 23,096 million (+42.4%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 15,839 million (+45.7%); litigation settlement loss JPY 2,158 million
